item.title: Students take on Fresh Food Co. in ‘Chopped’ style competition

item.description: The Alabama Supreme Court heard police officer Mac Bailey Marquette’s plea for immunity in Moody Music Building on Wednesday. item.title: City Council indefinitely tables Springbrook commercial development grant
item.description: The Tuscaloosa City Council indefinitely tabled a $5.57 million grant in tax incentives for the Delaney Property Group of Mobile on Tuesday. The grant would have allowed for a commercial development on 5.61 acres in Springbrook, a neighborhood in Tuscaloosa. item.title: State House passes bill to repeal law requiring School of Social Work at UA
item.description: The Alabama state House passed a bill on Thursday to remove language from existing law requiring the establishment of a School of Social Work of Alabama. It passed 76-14.
